rules: FIELD NOTES live inside BUILD JOURNAL; they are not a second publication system.
Cross-build notes may connect ideas at the thesis level without forcing products into the same market or audience.
Personal source-note material requires deliberate editorial review before public rendering.
Distinguish contemporaneous notes from reconstructed history.
Do not imply unbuilt functionality is live.
Use provenance selectively when it teaches how meaningful work happened.
Agent contribution must describe bounded work, not raw internal activity.
Public evidence should point to a verifiable artifact, release, deployment, result, test, or decision record where possible.
Never publish credentials, permissions, raw prompts, private task state, raw agent conversations, or unpublished founder/customer context.
Current state is editorial content, not presence tracking.
No fake agent, task, customer, or activity counts.
No machine-derived claim without a verifiable public source and editorial rule.
Core navigation must remain usable when the current-state renderer fails.
